thesis.purpose: The single page-opening claim. One per page, Archivo at wdth 112.

section.purpose: Section headings and the active strain binomial. Full sentences, not labels.

body.purpose: Ledes and running argument, held to a 58ch measure.

small.purpose: Chart captions, the read bar, slip field values.

legend.purpose: Uppercase field labels, column headers and plate coordinates at wdth 94. The floor of the system and the floor for 1080p video.

motion.name: step-two
motion.purpose: Every state transition in the system: link underline, well scale, well rim. No easing curve.

motion.name: column-read
motion.purpose: The plate reads itself once on load, column by column. Suppressed entirely under prefers-reduced-motion, which renders the plate already read.

motion.name: tonal-cut
motion.purpose: Strain-plate ground change on hover and selection. Switching strains is a hard cut, never a pan.

notCanonized: --ease-read (cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)) is declared in the @theme block of web/app/globals.css and referenced nowhere in the build. It is dead, not a motion token; the shipped motion grammar is step-only.

The direction contract specifies a 56px plate-edge strip, a ~64px thesis and a 90ms per-column plate read. The build ships a ~50px strip, a clamp(2.1rem, 3.7vw, 3.25rem) thesis and 72ms per column. The build is recorded; the contract is not.

components.name: Well
components.description: The system's primitive: one compound, liquid height is its nearest-training Tanimoto and turbidity is its predicted probability, with the domain cutoff drawn across it.

narrative.overview:
The surface is a 96-well microdilution plate on a reader's bench, lit from behind. Nothing here is a dashboard dressed in lab colours: the ground is the colour of a resazurin well where nothing grew, the wells are circles of polystyrene with liquid in them, and a measurement is drawn as a physical quantity, a liquid level, a turbidity, a line across the glass, before it is ever written as a number. The register is clinical and unhurried. Density is high because a plate is dense, but every dense region is a grid, never a collage.

The system is dark only and committed, not accented. One colour carries the entire page; the three others are reserved, and their rarity is what makes them readable in a compressed video frame at 1080p. There are no gradients used as surface, no glow, no glass, no card stack, no rounded panels. Depth exists only where a real well has it: a 1px rim and the specular line the reader's lamp puts on the plastic.

The hardest commitment in the built system is that state is geometry. A candidate outside the applicability domain is struck through with a diagonal; a fingerprint twin wears an inked ring; an unmarked well is in-domain. Colour moves with those marks but never carries them alone, so the whole read survives greyscale and survives a bad projector.
keyCharacteristics: One committed ground (#081a42) across every surface; no light mode exists.
State drawn in form, strike, ring, absence, never in hue alone.
Three type registers and no more, with the display scale set by Archivo's width axis rather than by weight.
Every measurement in Martian Mono with tabular figures; prose in Archivo.
Square everything except the well, which is a circle because a well is round.
Motion is step-only: steps(2, end), 72–90ms, no easing curve anywhere.

rules.name: The Committed Ground Rule
rules.body: #081a42 carries the page. A new surface does not get its own background colour; it gets a hairline and a heading. Only the plate edge (#050f2b) and the selected strain (#0b2252) may differ, and both are already spoken for.

rules.name: The Growth Reservation Rule
rules.body: Growth pink is never decoration, never a brand accent, never a hover. It appears only where a value cannot be banked: the out-of-domain tier, a value below the read line, and a missing record. If pink appears on a screen with no such value on it, the screen is wrong.

rules.name: The Form-Not-Hue Rule
rules.body: Every tier distinction ships as a mark as well as a colour: struck diagonal for outside the read, an inked ring for a fingerprint twin, no mark at all for in-domain. Print the screen in greyscale; if a tier disappears, it was never drawn.

rules.name: The Three Registers Rule
rules.body: Body, small, legend. Three sizes carry all non-display text, and a new component picks one of them rather than inventing a fourth. Display is two clamps and is reserved for the thesis and section heads.

rules.name: The Width-Axis Rule
rules.body: Scale is expressed through Archivo's width axis, not through a weight ramp: display sets wdth 112, legends set wdth 94. Weight moves between 400, 500 and 600 and no further; font-synthesis-weight is off, so a faked weight will simply not render.

rules.name: The Measurement-Is-Mono Rule
rules.body: If a string is a measured or recorded value, it is set in Martian Mono with tnum on. If it is an argument about those values, it is Archivo. There is no third case.

rules.name: The One Rail Rule
rules.body: Every section uses the same 27rem argument rail against a fluid evidence column. A new section does not get a new grid; it gets a heading, a lede, and whatever evidence belongs in the right-hand column.

rules.name: The Comparison-On-The-Line Rule
rules.body: No value ships without its comparison on the same axis or the same line: every score against its base rate, every metric against its ceiling, every predicted probability against its distance. A lone number is an incomplete component.

rules.name: The Transmitted-Light Rule
rules.body: Light in this world comes through the plate from behind. Shadows exist only on the well and only at 1–2px. No glow, no glass, no soft drop shadow under a panel, and no shadow at all on anything rectangular.

rules.name: The Step-Only Rule
rules.body: Every transition in this system is steps(2, end) at 72–90ms, or a 90ms linear colour change. There is no easing curve anywhere. The plate reads itself once on load, column by column at 72ms per column, and then stops; prefers-reduced-motion renders it already read.

rules.name: The No-Overlay Rule
rules.body: The detail of a well opens in place, under the plate, across the full page width. Nothing in this system floats above the plate: no modal, no popover, no tooltip.

dos: Do carry the ground #081a42 on every surface and separate panels with a 1px polystyrene hairline at 14%, not with a tinted box.
Do draw a measured quantity as a physical channel first, liquid height, turbidity, a mark on a shared axis, and write the number beside it in mono.
Do ship every value with its comparison on the same line or the same axis: score against base rate, metric against ceiling, probability against distance.
Do give every tier a mark as well as a colour, and check the screen in greyscale before shipping it.
Do keep type to the three registers (1 / 0.875 / 0.75rem) and express display scale through Archivo's width axis (wdth 112 display, 94 legend).
Do set every identifier, hash, Tanimoto, SMILES and DOI in Martian Mono with tabular figures.
Do state a defect in words, in growth pink, where the defect is, a missing plant, a missing DOI, a score that is not evidence.
Do replace the plate with a list below md rather than shrinking it.
donts: Don't introduce a light mode or a second background colour. color-scheme is dark and the ground is the world.
Don't spend growth pink on anything that is not growth, out-of-domain, or a missing record, not on hover, not on a brand accent, not on an error that is merely an error.
Don't put a shadow, glow, blur or glass effect on anything rectangular. Depth belongs to the well's rim and meniscus and nowhere else.
Don't use a gradient as a surface. The only gradient in the system draws the 1px strike across an out-of-domain well.
Don't round a rectangle. Radius belongs to the well (50%) and to the 2px focus ring.
Don't add an easing curve. If a change needs to feel smooth, it is the wrong change.
Don't float detail over the plate in a modal, popover or tooltip.
Don't encode a tier in colour alone, and don't let a number appear without the thing it must be read against.
Don't add a fourth type size or a synthesised weight; font-synthesis-weight is off and a faked weight will not render.
